items.docs: A deactivated secret is hidden from users who do not have a role containing the View Inactive Secrets permission. Secret Server uses these "soft deletes" to maintain the audit history for all data. However, deactivated secrets are still accessible by administrators (like a permanent Recycle Bin) to ensure that audit history is maintained and to support recovery. A user must have the "View Inactive Secrets" permission in addition to Owner permission on a secret to access the secret View page for

params.name: filter.allowDoubleLocks
params.description: Whether to allow DoubleLocks as part of the search. True by default.

params.name: filter.doNotCalculateTotal
params.description: Whether to return the total number of secrets matching the filters. False by default. If false, the total can be retrieved separately by calling /v1/secrets/search-total with the same arguments used in the search.

params.name: filter.doubleLockId
params.description: Only include Secrets with this DoubleLock ID assigned in the search results.

params.name: filter.extendedFields
params.description: An array of names of Secret Template fields to return.  Only exposed fields can be returned.  This parameter will be ignored if ExtFieldsCombined is sent.

params.name: filter.extendedTypeId
params.description: If not null, return only secrets matching the specified extended mapping type as defined on the secret’s template.

params.name: filter.extFieldsCombined
params.description: A comma delimited list of all extended fields to return.  All fields must be marked as exposed for display.  When populated this value will be used instead of ExtendedFields[].  Combining the fields decreases the size of the GET URL to avoid the 2048 character length restriction in IIS.

params.name: filter.folderId
params.description: If not null, returns only secrets within the specified folder.

params.name: filter.hasLauncher
params.description: Whether to only return secrets with or without launchers. If null, returns secrets regardless of whether they have launchers.

params.name: filter.heartbeatStatus
params.description: If not null, returns only secrets with a certain heartbeat status.

params.name: filter.includeActive
params.description: Whether to include active secrets in results (when excluded equals true).

params.name: filter.includeInactive
params.description: Whether to include inactive secrets in results.

params.name: filter.includeRestricted
params.description: Whether to include restricted secrets in results. Restricted secrets are secrets that are DoubleLocked, require approval, or require a comment to view.

params.name: filter.includeSubFolders
params.description: Whether to include secrets in subfolders of the specified folder.

params.name: filter.isExactMatch
params.description: Whether to do an exact match of the search text or a partial match. If an exact match, the entire secret name, field value, or list option in a list field must match the search text.

params.name: filter.onlyCheckedOutSecrets
params.description: Whether to only return secrets that are or are not checked out. If null, returns secrets regardless of whether they are checked out.

params.name: filter.onlyRPCEnabled
params.description: Whether to only include secrets whose template has Remote Password Changing enabled.

params.name: filter.onlySecretsCheckedOutByUser
params.description: Whether to only return secrets that are or are not checked out by the querying user. If null, returns secrets regardless of whether they are checked out.

params.name: filter.onlySharedWithMe
params.description: When true only Secrets where you are not the owner and the Secret was shared explicitly with your user id will be returned.

params.name: filter.passwordTypeIds
params.description: If not null, returns only secrets matching the specified password types.

params.name: filter.permissionRequired
params.description: Specify whether to filter by List, View, Edit, or Owner permission. Default is List.

params.name: filter.scope
params.description: Specify whether to search All, Recent, or Favorites

params.name: filter.searchField
params.description: If set, restricts the search to only match secrets where the value of the field specified by name contains the search text.

params.name: filter.searchFieldSlug
params.description: If set, restricts the search to only match secrets where the value of the field specified by the slug name contains the search text. This will override SearchField.

params.name: filter.searchText
params.description: The text to match in the secret name, field value, or list field contents.

params.name: filter.secretIds
params.description: If not null or empty, returns only secrets matching the specified secret ids.

params.name: filter.secretTemplateIds
params.description: If not null or empty, returns only secrets matching the specified templates.

params.description: A comma delimited list of all secret template IDs.  When populated this value will be used instead of SecretTemplateIds[].  Combining the fields decreases the size of the GET URL to avoid the 2048 character length restriction in IIS.

params.name: filter.siteId
